## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Scope

- [ ] Framework methodology or terminology
- [ ] Schema or example
- [ ] REEF implementation
- [ ] Research or evaluation
- [ ] Documentation or governance

## Validation

Describe checks performed and evidence reviewed.

## Publication safety

- [ ] No proprietary, confidential, client-specific, or personal data is included.
- [ ] Empirical claims are supported or clearly labeled as hypotheses.
- [ ] Canonical effort values use Person-Hours (PH).
- [ ] User-visible changes are recorded in `CHANGELOG.md`.
